column1: # smoke_scope.tsv -- which probes a `--tier smoke` walk runs.   (scripts/walk_smoke_select.py reads it)
# A smoke walk is cold reset + install + the probes below. It can NEVER produce `verdict CLEAN`
# (post_walk_qa.sh writes SMOKE-PASS / SMOKE-FAILED / SMOKE-PARTIAL into walks/<v>.smoke.tsv). FULL is required before any
# console walk and any public tag.
# Columns: class <TAB> key <TAB> probes (comma separated, exact probe names, no substrings)
#   blocking   LAUNCH DIRECTIVE item 5, always run.
#   component  run only when that component CHANGED since the last FULL walk record. Components are the `repo` column of
#              OS003 manifest/capability_manifest.tsv, reached through the capability_id of each OS003
#              cuts/<v>/MUST_CONTAIN.tsv row of every cut after the last FULL record. A BOM row with capability_id none,
#              or a capability absent from the manifest, or a cut whose BOM cannot be read, widens to ALL components
#              (fail wide, never narrow). No FULL record in the walk store also means ALL components.
# EVERY probe on disk must appear exactly once below (tests/test_walk_smoke_scope_covers_every_probe.sh): a new probe
# cannot silently fall out of smoke.
